items.title: Password
items.description:
<span>Two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a
 word-association game. One player tries to guess a word based on clues 
offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver 
inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is 
lost. Wh
